currentSafeClaim: KOSHA exact trust pins and Phase A materialization are proven; full 1040-row KOSHA Guide corpus is not yet launch-ready for authoritative grounding or embedding.

launchReadinessBlockers.requiredBeforeRelease: Source PDF text or reviewed OCR body must be non-empty and hash/provenance linked.
Every launch row must resolve to official item URL, file ID, publication date, and current/retired state.
Every heuristic delta must receive explicit reviewed ground-truth labels before KOSHA Guide controls are embedded or treated as product evidence.
Remaining controls must be re-derived from source body and cross-domain fixtures must pass.
Official current versions must replace stale versions and retired rows must be excluded after approval.
Source-grounded summaries must replace fallback and bullet-only values.
Ranked and hybrid production branches must be observed with KOSHA evidence reflection before broad retrieval claims.

preApprovalWorkstreams.exitCriteria: Zero-mutation diff maps all active rows and quarantines unresolved rows.
Every launch row has non-empty official body or reviewed OCR body, otherwise it is excluded from active retrieval.
KOSHA controls are source-derived and cross-task contamination fixtures pass.
Observed production retrieval branches reflect KOSHA evidence into documents without generic prose-only matches.

embeddingRecommendation.reason: The corpus is valuable as the KOSHA Guide layer after SIF, but embedding current rows would mostly index titles, fallback summaries, and derived controls rather than official bodies.
requiredBeforeEmbedding: Backfill official URL, file ID, published date, current/retired status, and content hash for every active KOSHA Guide row.
Hydrate or OCR the 818 empty-body rows, or quarantine unresolved rows outside active retrieval.
Replace 822 fallback/duplicate summaries with source-grounded summaries.
Review 70 operational-control heuristic-delta rows and 1 cross-domain control candidate before treating controls as KOSHA-derived.
Update 7 version mismatches and retire 1 officially retired local row.
Observe ranked and hybrid production retrieval branches with KOSHA evidence reflection.
Split SIF and KOSHA Guide vector retrieval by corpus kind, index, and RPC.
Run zero-mutation dry-run diff, focused tests, post-migration verification, and explicit user approval before any DB mutation or embedding upload.
